svg.title: coderprint: 760k new lines written, all time
svg.desc: 759,918 new lines written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 1,940 commits across all branches, 39 active days, a longest streak of 20 days, a current streak of 20 days, and 13 languages written. They came in 3 bursts of 47k, 194k and 518k lines. Share of new lines by language: Rust 45%, Python 23%, TypeScript 10%, Markdown 10%, JavaScript 7%, TeX 3%, HTML 1%, other languages 1%.
